summary: Final pre-deploy regression for Fork·Fate. Backend: 5/5 pytest passing for new POST /api/crawls/{code}/position + GET /api/crawls/{code}/positions (upsert=one entry per member with latest coords, invalid lat=422), plus GET /crawls/{code}, GET /crawls/leaderboard, POST /crawls/{code}/checkin regression. Frontend (mobile 390x800): Pub Crawl dialog auto-opens on /c/{code}, segmented tabs crawl-tab-stops / crawl-tab-map render, crawl-next-chip-0 shows 'Start here', crawl-scroll-cue hides after scrolling .ff-crawl-body, footer has 'New crawl' + 'Share with group' buttons. LIVE CREW PINS: after seeding position via API (Bob at 41.295,-96.115 for crawl SA6JY9YY), /c/SA6JY9YY dialog Map tab shows '1 crew pin live — blue dots are your people.' caption AND a marker containing 'Bob' in the leaflet DOM. CUISINE BINGO: /bingo renders bingo-grid with 25 cells, bingo-stamps='1', bingo-share-button click completes with zero JS errors after anchor.click override. FATE JOURNAL: /journal with 3 seeded entries shows title, journal-stat-total='3', 3 entry rows, journal-share-button click with zero JS errors; clearing ff_journal shows journal-empty and hides share button. COLLECTION /rituals: renders rituals grid + heists-grid + bingo-collection-card. Deal-flow, dish-dare, fate-of-day, and latte rare-ritual already verified in iteration_57 (same session).
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx remains a large monolith (~1500+ lines) — consider splitting fateOfDay / landFate / crawl helpers into modules (carry-over from iter_57).

Position endpoint /api/crawls/{code}/position has no auth and rate_limit(120) — abuse potential to spam pins for any known code. Acceptable pre-launch given TTL=15min and 30-doc GET cap, but consider a signed member token in v2.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on scoped new features (crew pins, bingo, journal, collection, crawl dialog tabs/scroll-cue/footer)

seed_data_creation: Created crawl code SA6JY9YY with 2 stops and posted a Bob position (member_id=testbob_ui_001) for live-crew-pin UI test. TTL will auto-expire in 15 min. Seeded ff_bingo and ff_journal in localStorage per instructions.
